title: Never Touch Your Brakes On A Downhill Curve (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Shift down before entering steep descents.

script.narration: Part 2! Shift down before entering steep descents.
What gear should you pick? Think fast. The right answer is a lower gear to use engine braking safely.
This stops your brake pads from overheating by letting the engine control your vehicle speed naturally.

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you use engine braking on mountains? Comment yes or no.

description:
Part 2 of our mountain driving safety series! Learn how to use engine braking safely on steep descents without destroying your car's brakes.

Never touch your brakes constantly on downhill curves. Master advanced driving techniques in under 60 seconds.
